L89: # Hook and Loop 101: Insights from The Pioneers
L90: 
L91: Everything You need to know about the iconic fastening system from the original creators at Velcro Companies.
L92: ## What Is a Hook and Loop Fastener?
L93: 
L94: Hook and loop is an innovative fastening system that can adhere, 【78†attach and secure a wide range of applications.】 The fastener has two sides that link to form a strong bond. One side features tiny hooks, while the other has nylon loops.
L95: 
L96: * * *
L97: 
L98: 【79†Image: Medical blood pressure band with hook and loop fastener from the VELCRO® Brand.†s23775.pcdn.co】
L99: ##
L100: 
L101: This revolutionary technology has spread across various industries thanks to its versatility, adaptability and ease of use. You may know it from sneakers, 【80†diaper tabs】 and blood pressure bands, among many other applications.
L102: 【81†Velcro Companies】 are proud to be the innovators behind the original hook and loop fastener. Although our products consist of hook and loop, not all hook and loop products are from the VELCRO® Brand.
L103: ## How does hook and loop work?
L104: 
L105: 【82†Hook and loop fasteners work】 by interlocking tiny hooks on one side with loops on the other side. Inspired by the shape of burdock burrs, the hooks catch onto the loops to form a secure connection. You disengage the fasteners by pulling apart the hooks from the loops.
L106: 
L107: Initially made from nylon, the product has advanced with technology, allowing us to adapt the fastener according to the application.
L108: 
L109: Here’s a microscopic look at both sides of a VELCRO® Brand fastener.

L167: ## The History of Hook and Loop
L168: 
L169: 【86†Our story began】 in 1941 when Swiss engineer George de Mestral noticed burrs sticking to his dog’s fur on a walk in the woods. Curious about how they worked, he created a fastening system that copied this natural hook design. He named his invention “Velcro,” a mix of the French words “velours” (velvet) and “crochet” (hook).
L170: De Mestral’s genius idea quickly took off and was adopted by many industries, including aerospace. In fact, NASA utilized it during the Apollo missions.
L171: 
L172: 【93†Image†s23775.pcdn.co】
L173: ## NASA and VELCRO® Brand Solutions
L174: 
L175: VELCRO® Brand fasteners played a key role in the Apollo 11 mission on July 20, 1969—the day humans first walked on the moon. NASA used around 3,300 square inches of our hook and loop fasteners in the command and lunar modules to meet the demands of space travel.
L176: 
L177: These fasteners helped secure instruments to spacesuits, anchor boots, organize tools, and store breathing equipment, proving essential in the harsh conditions of space.

L259: ## FAQs
L260: 
L261: Did NASA invent VELCRO® Brand fasteners?
L262: 
L263: No, NASA did not invent VELCRO® Brand fasteners. The VELCRO® Brand was first developed in the 1940s by Swiss engineer Georges de Mestral. However, NASA extensively utilized our fasteners to tackle space travel’s unique challenges, like extreme temperatures and zero gravity. They used about 3,300 square inches of VELCRO® Brand tape to secure instruments, organize tools and support astronauts.
L264: How did George de Mestral get the idea of making VELCRO® Brand fasteners?
L265: 
L266: 【104†In 1941, Swiss engineer George de Mestral】 became intrigued by the burdock burrs that adhered to his dog’s fur during a hike. After noticing the fastening capabilities of the burr’s tiny “hooks,” he dedicated himself to finding a way to apply this innovative mechanism to textiles. This effort eventually led to the creation of what we now call hook and loop.
L267: 
L268: Is hook and loop tape the same as a VELCRO® Brand fastener?
L269: The VELCRO® Brand is the innovator of the original hook and loop fastener. We have a variety of products that utilize hook and loop technology. That said, they are not the same. Other companies may use our technology, but this does not make them VELCRO® Brand fasteners.
L270: 
L271: Where did Velcro Companies get its name?
L272: 
L273: 【86†George De Mestral created the iconic VELCRO® trademark】 by blending the French words “Velours” (meaning velvet) and “Crochet” (meaning hook).
L274: What is the real term for a VELCRO® Brand fastener?
L275: 
L276: The generic name for what most people call a VELCRO® Brand fastener is hook and loop. This is because the fastener has two sides: one made entirely of tiny hooks and the other of little loops, which the hooks grip onto.
L277: 
L278: Are hook and loop fasteners waterproof?
L279: It all depends on the specific fastener—some are waterproof or water-resistant, and others aren’t. We have finished products that are water-resistant, such as those in our 【105†Kitchen and Bath】 line. B2B clients can also work with our engineers to tailor products so they are UV and water-resistant. 【1†Contact us】 for recommendations on the most suitable fastener for your specific application.
L280: 
L281: What is the fuzzy side of a VELCRO® Brand fastener called?
L282: The fuzzy side of our fasteners is the loop side, and the rough side is the hook.
L283: 
L284: Why do people say hook and loop instead of VELCRO® Brand fastener?
L285: 
L286: Hook and loop is the generic term for a VELCRO® Brand fastener. VELCRO® Brand fasteners contain hook and loop technology, but not all hook and loop fasteners are made by the VELCRO® Brand.
L287: 
L288: What are VELCRO® Brand hook and loop fasteners made from?
L289: VELCRO® Brand fasteners are typically made from nylon or polyester. The hook side consists of stiff nylon or polyester hooks, while the loop side is made from softer, flexible nylon loops. These materials are durable, lightweight and resistant to wear.
L290: 
L291: What advancements have been made to hook and loop fasteners over time?
L292: Over the years, several advancements have been made to our fasteners:
L293: – Heat-Resistant Fasteners: Developed to maintain holding power even in high temperatures, making them suitable for automotive and aerospace applications.
L294: – Low-Profile Fasteners: Thinner and more flexible, ideal for sleek designs in consumer electronics and fashion.
L295: 【106†–】 【106†ECO Collection:】 Made from recycled materials, supporting sustainability initiatives.
L296: – Smart Fastening Systems: Integrating with wearable tech and medical devices, offering features like infrared camouflage for defense applications.
L297: Are any applications being explored using the technology?
L298: 
L299: Innovation is at our core. Our engineers continuously seek new ways for VELCRO® Brand technology to provide easy solutions—for businesses and consumers.
